product: Real fm-remote-job --serve plus sourceable staging/probe API; isolated git-init roots and account/state directories; native macOS /bin/bash 3.2.57
benchmark_method: 12-second idle window per instance; kqueue NOTE_FORK tracks direct child fork events (coalescing makes nonzero counts lower bounds); libproc proc_pid_rusage measures worker plus reaped-child system CPU. Not host-wide hub measurements. One-core and 16-logical-core machine percentages both reported.
targeted_existing_e2e: /bin/bash tests/fm-remote-job-active-wait.test.sh exited 0: notification suppression, same-home serialization/prompt scheduling with FIFO and fallback, full-pipe staging, publisher stderr preservation, live worker heartbeat-failure diagnostics and waiting-marker cleanup
other_attempts: dtrace -l -n syscall::*fork*:entry refused: DTrace requires additional privileges. Used unprivileged kqueue/libproc instead.
ui: No UI surface changed; CLI/API state and benchmark JSON are the reviewer-visible evidence.
